rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to describe doing something politely.

example.english: I politely thanked the staff member.
example.traditional: 我有禮貌咁同個職員講唔該。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 lai5 maau6 gam2 tung4 go3 zik1 jyun4 gong2 m4 goi1

rows.note: Use this when the politeness is especially courteous, deferential, or restrained in an interaction.

example.english: You don't have to speak to me so politely; just say what's up.
example.traditional: 你唔使客氣咁同我講，有咩事直講啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3 gam2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 jau5 me1 si6 zik6 gong2 laa1
